name: @octocodeai/octocode-native
description: Native Octocode CLI and MCP server: the Rust workspace and the per-platform binary packages (npm/<platform>)
author: Guy Bary <bgauryy@octocodeai.com>

scripts.test: yarn test:scripts && yarn test:node && yarn test:rust
scripts.test:scripts: node tests/platform.test.cjs && node scripts/platform-packages.cjs --check && node --test tests/build-publication.test.cjs tests/fetch-binary.test.cjs
scripts.lint: yarn run -T oxlint -c ../../.oxlintrc.json --type-aware --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives . && cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: yarn fmt:rust:check && yarn lint && yarn deny && yarn shear && yarn typecheck && yarn test && yarn workspace @octocodeai/config check:tool-contract
